chapter_scope: v03-c07 and v03-c08 only; remaining four Volume 3 chapters and its full assessment/project package remain unfinished
review_type: Author analytic, numerical, source and instructional review; not independent certification

reviewed.reasoning: Audited estimator/estimand distinction and design/model randomness; without-replacement covariance and finite-population correction; pair-difference proof of sample-variance unbiasedness; stratified independence and weights; Horvitz–Thompson positive-inclusion expectation and joint-inclusion variance; bias/MSE decomposition and unbiasedness/consistency counterexamples; iid sample-variance unbiasedness and consistency under finite second moments. Audited Bernoulli interior/endpoints, exponential concavity/exposure/censoring assumptions, support-dependent uniform MLE and its mean/consistency; exact conditional bootstrap mean moments and persistent endpoint atom. Audited finite versus asymptotic coverage, normal interval inversion, orthogonal normal-density factorization and t pivot, composite-null size and least-favorable monotone coupling, discrete inclusive-tail p-value validity, matching inversion, Wilson quadratic, exact binomial equal-tail coverage and boundaries. Reviewed alternative-law power/sample-size algebra, Bonferroni and Holm strong-control proofs, FWER/FDR distinction, and intersection-union equivalence calibration.
reviewed.arithmetic: Independently enumerated all without-replacement samples for two original populations and every feasible sample size; checked true/design-unbiased estimated variances, draw covariance, stratified states, unequal-probability estimates/covariance expansion, shrinkage MSE and numerical likelihood optima. Exhaustively enumerated 256 and 27 empirical-bootstrap index resamples and the endpoint-maximum atom. Integrated normal coverage/tails and the t3 density independently; checked orthonormal mean/residual identities. Recomputed exact rational binomial sizes/powers and every attainable tail cutoff for multiple composite-null laws; bisected exact endpoints, checked 3,003 finite coverage-grid points and Wilson quadratic endpoints. Independently integrated alternative-law power; verified neighboring integer sample sizes; enumerated mixed true/false discrete-null arrangements plus perfect dependence for Holm, and checked equivalence interval/statistics/null-boundary probabilities.
reviewed.solutions: Solved all sixteen exercises against their exact prompts. Checked units, support/boundary cases, equal-tail versus one-sided labels, censoring event count versus exposure, bootstrap index probabilities, exact versus estimated variances, effect/cost thresholds and the requirement to stop Holm at its first failure. Open-report critique has explicit causal, calibration and economic criteria with a concrete repair; it is not graded as a unique investment recommendation.
reviewed.instruction: Selection and population targets precede standard-error formulas. All design/likelihood/conditional-resampling methods needed in the exercises are derived in the chapter. Confidence coverage, test errors, power and posterior belief are explained separately. Matrix orthonormality and normal density factorization establish the t pivot without an unintroduced independence assertion. Full general bootstrap asymptotics, advanced selective/sequential and FDR theory remain named later/further study and are not claimed proved here.
reviewed.sources: Retrieved primary author/official survey, MLE, empirical-bootstrap, normal-interval and z/t testing materials, the original ASA statement, author-hosted multiple-testing notes and official NIST binomial intervals. Catalogue URLs and inspection scopes are accurate. Numerical examples, exercises and exposition are original; sources are method/further-study routes rather than external review of the manuscript.
reviewed.structure: Each chapter supplies two worked examples, eight exercises and full solutions, explicit design/moment/normality/support assumptions and units, teach-back/delayed checks, method-specific sources and successor route. The planned successor is linked to its curriculum specification, not a nonexistent manuscript. Full structural and numerical verifier passes required before acceptance.

corrections: Changed the planned Chapter 9 successor link to the curriculum specification before acceptance, avoiding a nonexistent local target.
Expanded the score-inversion quadratic so the Wilson endpoints are taught as a derivation, not only a displayed formula.
Checked exact binomial-size versus nominal-level and confidence-tail labels explicitly; retained their differences rather than rounding the experiment to its desired level.
limitations: No independent human reviewer or learner trial.
Finite coverage grids and likelihood searches do not prove general coverage, asymptotics or global optimization; the stated exact results have separate written derivations.
Ordinary bootstrap consistency is introduced with conditions and a concrete failure; a full general bootstrap theorem is further study.
FDR is defined and compared with FWER, but advanced FDR methods/theorems are reserved for later empirical material.
All example models/data are stipulated synthetic experiments, not observations of October markets or customers.
Visual/mobile/print UI QA remains pending after the earlier browser-policy rejection.
acceptance: Accepted by the author after analytic, exercise, source and integrated numerical/structural checks. Remaining Volume 3 manuscripts/package and recorded Chapter 12 proof follow-up, external learner evaluation and visual/mobile/print UI QA remain outstanding.
